purpose: Independently justify a reusable-tool invocation horizon without consulting Foundry validation-v6 artifacts or outcomes.

required_properties: explicitly described as a production request trace
stable per-model identity within the trace

rejected_as_primary.mlcommons_inference_loadgen: A benchmark-generated query schedule, not a deployment-demand trace.
rejected_as_primary.azure_lmm_inference_dataset_2025: A real production trace, but its public request rows do not expose a stable model or service identity suitable for estimating per-artifact reuse.

reference_source.role: Independent confirmation that public production GenAI demand traces exist; not used to choose N-star.

predeclared_estimator.population: Every nonempty checkpoint_model_version_id in the selected trace.
predeclared_estimator.measure: Count rows whose status equals Succeeded for each model identity.
predeclared_estimator.rationale: The lower quartile is a conservative independently fixed reuse horizon and avoids selecting a central or upper-tail value after seeing Foundry economics.

scientific_boundary.remaining_requirement: Freeze locally reproducible source bytes and prospectively justify transfer from Stable Diffusion model demand to the held-out Foundry workload stream.
